utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Faye—sorry, I keep mixing things up. Wait, the repair drive's not for the benches, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No, it’s for fixing household items—Saturday morning at the community center, but I have to juggle it with school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right—household items, Saturday. But remind me, is that this Saturday or the one after the park cleanup?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Opal mentioned you got the list of driveways needing patchwork... that sounds like a good place to start this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I saw the list—looks like a solid plan. I can tackle a few of those before I head out Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to hear. I might swing by and lend a hand if I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you actually think that old USB drive is going to fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, if the tools are ready and the driveway isn't a mess, the drive might actually work—but I still worry about people tripping over extension cords or something.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're saying the driveway's fine, but the real hazard is people tripping over cords? That's your bigger concern?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Tess, quick—what's the deal with the repair drive? Just give me the short version, I'm on my way out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's this little USB drive Faye's been passing around—everyone's got their doubts, but I'm hoping it's the fix we need for the old water pump.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, USB drive for the water pump. Just tell me if I need to sign up for anything—I'm out the door in two minutes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Ira — are we talking about the repair drive this weekend? I want to make sure I have the details right before I start telling people about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh yeah, the repair drive! I overheard something about it when I was picking up milk. What's the plan exactly?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's this weekend—Gus is bringing his toolbox and spare parts, and I'm supposed to spread the word to the Hillcrest neighbors. I'm just double-checking everything before I invite anyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure about the extension cords, Gus—maybe check with the organizers? I just heard folks are bringing tools and such.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, good idea—I'll bring 'em just in case. Better to have extra cords than be short, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's true, always better to be prepared. I just hope people actually show up with useful stuff, not broken junk like Kira was saying.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's the spirit, Opal! Yeah, we're gathering at the shed at 9 sharp—bring your own hammer if you've got one!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—9 at the shed with my hammer. And just to double-check, is the appliance drop-off still happening, or was that a different thing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the appliance drop-off is a separate thing next month—this weekend is all about the benches and maybe fixing that wobbly picnic table near the playground.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Uli, I wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, thanks for letting me know, Rosa. Sunday works fine for me, I'll still bring the mower.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Uli! I'm glad Sunday works for you. I'll make a note that you're bringing the mower.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Quinn, I appreciate the invite, but I've already got my Saturday mapped out—weather permitting, I'll be tending to my rose bushes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, Eli. Maybe next time if your roses can wait.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's right, Leo. My roses don't prune themselves, you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam! Don't forget, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center—bring anything broken!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh right, thanks Vik! I've got my toolbox ready and I'll rummage through my garage tonight for anything worth fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you Saturday! I'll be there with Danny's blender and maybe some old chairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Cleo, just a heads up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Mara! I'll adjust my supply count for Sunday then—good thing I've been tallying those bolts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks for keeping on top of that! See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm thinking this Saturday morning—does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday morning works for me. What time exactly are we kicking things off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Let's start around 9 a.m. — that way we can get a good chunk done before the heat sets in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Tess, I'm a bit fuzzy on the details—did we decide on a date for that repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, not yet, Noah! Faye was just asking about timing too, since she's juggling school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, right, right—school schedules. I think last I heard, folks were leaning toward a Saturday morning, but I can't remember which one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Right, that's where we... uh... fix things together? I think I've got a lamp somewhere, but it might actually be a broken clock.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: A lamp or a clock, huh? Either way, bring it along—we'll figure it out together. These repair drives are great for that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good point, good point. I'll just dig through the garage and grab whatever I find that's broken.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! Have you heard about the community repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park benches and could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I heard about it, but I'm more worried about parking than the benches. That cul-de-sac is going to be packed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh don't worry about that, Pia! I'll save you a spot right in front of my house—I've got the best driveway for squeezing in extra cars!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Kira, I'm so glad you're here! I wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you actually think that old USB drive is going to fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh no, not a USB drive—I mean the whole neighborhood repair drive! Tools, elbow grease, everyone pitching in to fix things together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Vik, maybe you can bring that thing you've been meaning to fix to the repair drive this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yeah, this Saturday at the community center! I'm bringing my broken lamp—Danny's bringing his blender too, you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, it'll be nice to see some old things working again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Mina, I've got a map of driveways that need patchwork for the repair drive—Dane just passed me the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, so when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We're kicking off Saturday at 9 AM at the park, then moving to the driveways.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, before we dive in—did you say you're bringing something for the drive? I want to make sure we have the right tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I signed up for the tools—just tell me where to drop 'em off and I'm good.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Bo! Can you meet me at the community center Saturday morning around 9? I want to double-check we've got everything covered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, sorry I'm late! Anything crucial I need to know for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Dane! Good timing — the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday works for me! Did anyone figure out what we're using to fix that old USB drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Uli, are you planning to go to the repair drive on Saturday? I'm trying to figure out a time that works with the kids' school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I'll be there. I've got a broken lawnmower that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'm glad you're going. Jules mentioned Saturday morning at the community center—maybe we can both aim to get there around 9, after I drop the kids off?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Jules, you coming to the repair drive? I've got my tools ready to go, and I hear there might be a few interesting projects to work on.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Sam! Gus is bringing his whole toolbox and spare parts too—it's shaping up to be a real team effort.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, glad to hear Gus is on board! I've been meaning to ask him about fixing that old fan of mine anyway.
